title: Parametric 3D video composer
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for planning parametric 3D Product Hub camera trajectories, realistic browser window and tab chrome layouts, upper-stage safe areas (x: 96..1824, y: 72..820) with dedicated lower caption bands (y: 836..1080), zero-double-exposure transitions, and subtle aura and edge-packet curves.
boundaries: Stage cards, browser windows and callouts stay inside x: 96..1824, y: 72..820; y: 836..1080 is reserved exclusively for captions.
Text-bearing shots transition only via 3D camera moves, clean cuts or dips to slate, never text-on-text crossfades.
Standard-library planner verifies coordinates before rendering and calls no remote APIs.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for planning parametric 3D Product Hub camera trajectories, realistic browser window and tab chrome layouts, and zero-double-exposure transitions

value.lets_workers: Plan 1x3 and 2x2 Product Hub 3D perspective camera zoom-in and zoom-out trajectories, compute desktop browser chrome geometry inside x: 96..1824, y: 72..820, verify zero collisions with the dedicated lower caption band y: 836..1080, reject text-on-text crossfades, and evaluate subtle Bezier edge-packet and aura glow curves.

flow.when: Generate overview, pillar focus, bridge zoom-out and finale hub camera poses.
Compute browser tab and omnibox chrome and check safe-stage and caption-band boundaries.
Block double-exposure dissolves and generate clamped aura and edge-packet curves.
Write a verified pre-render composition check noun.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 1x3 Product Hub scene recomputed by test_composer.py: 19.7 s C2-continuous camera trajectory across 11 segments, a 1600x700 browser window with 3 tabs inside x: 96..1824, y: 72..820, captions isolated in y: 836..1080, and camera-move transitions with zero double exposures.

nouns.title: Guardrail: stage UI stays inside y: 72..820 and captions stay inside y: 836..1080
nouns.category_reason: Eliminates caption-over-proof collisions structurally at layout time.

value.rule: On a 1920x1080 canvas, all stage cards, browser chrome and callouts remain inside x: 96..1824, y: 72..820, leaving a 16 px gutter above the dedicated lower caption band y: 836..1080.
value.how_it_is_checked: verify_safe_area_and_caption_band emits a blocker caption_band_collision for any non-caption element intersecting y: 836..1080.

nouns.title: Guardrail: forbid crossfades and dissolves between shots containing text or UI chrome
nouns.category_reason: Prevents ghosted overlapping text during transitions.

value.rule: Adjacent shots that both display text or UI chrome transition only via 3D camera moves, hard cuts or dips to clean slate.
value.how_it_is_checked: validate_zero_double_exposure flags crossfade, dissolve or alpha_blend transitions between text-bearing shots as blocker violations.

nouns.title: Guardrail: clamp card aura opacity at or below 0.22 and fade edge packets to zero at borders
nouns.category_reason: Keeps visual emphasis refined without neon glare or clipped particles.

value.rule: Focused card aura opacity never exceeds 0.22, and quadratic Bezier edge packets multiply opacity by 4*u*(1-u) so endpoints fade cleanly to 0.0.
value.how_it_is_checked: compute_card_aura and interpolate_edge_packet enforce ceiling clamping and endpoint zeroing.

nouns.title: Motion profile: 1x3 and 2x2 Product Hub 3D perspective camera trajectory
nouns.category_reason: Specifies camera pose sequence, focal projection and C2 quintic easing.

nouns.title: Layout rules: 1080p upper safe stage, lower caption band and desktop browser chrome
nouns.category_reason: Deterministic pixel coordinate contract for programmatic video scenes.

nouns.title: Transition and curve rules: zero double exposures, clamped card auras and Bezier packets
nouns.category_reason: Defines allowed transition types and parametric accent curves.

nouns.title: Tool card: parametric 3D camera, browser layout and transition verifier
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python standard-library package pinned by path, file count and digest.

value.name: parametric 3D video composer
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
commands: python -m parametric_composer browser --box 160 96 1760 796 --tabs Overview Runs Evidence
does: Plans 1x3 and 2x2 Product Hub 3D perspective camera trajectories and projects 3D stage coordinates.
Calculates desktop browser chrome rects and verifies x: 96..1824, y: 72..820 safe-stage and y: 836..1080 caption-band separation.
Validates zero text-on-text double exposures and evaluates Bezier edge-packet and aura curves.
does_not: Run a browser, encode MP4 files, call remote APIs or approve post-render visual quality without frame inspection.

nouns.title: Template: verified 3D camera, browser layout and transition composition check

value.describes: a pre-render verification summary recording Product Hub trajectory timing, browser viewport bounds, safe-area compliance and zero-double-exposure transition checks

nouns.title: Worked example input: synthetic 1x3 Product Hub scene with browser window and camera-move transitions
nouns.category_reason: Synthetic scene specification recomputed by test_composer.py.

nouns.title: Worked example output: recomputed pre-render composition check
nouns.category_reason: Deterministic verification output validated against template.composition-check.

verbs.title: Plan a 1x3 or 2x2 Product Hub 3D camera trajectory
verbs.summary: Compute overview, pillar zoom-in, pillar focus, bridge zoom-out and finale hub 3D camera poses with quintic smootherstep easing and pinhole screen projections.
verbs.outcome: A timed 3D camera trajectory and world-space pillar card boxes.

slots.name: hub_config
slots.description: Pin of the grid mode and pillar identifiers.

steps: Run plan_product_hub_trajectory for the requested 1x3 or 2x2 grid.
Project overview card corners with project_point_3d to confirm all cards sit inside x: 96..1824, y: 72..820.

acceptance.check: Adjacent segments share exact boundary poses and quintic easing derivatives vanish at endpoints.
Projected overview pillar boxes fall within STAGE_SAFE_BOX.

verbs.title: Compute browser chrome layout and verify safe-stage and caption-band bounds
verbs.summary: Calculate desktop browser window, traffic-light controls, tab strip, omnibox and inner viewport coordinates, and check every stage and caption box against x: 96..1824, y: 72..820 and y: 836..1080.
verbs.outcome: Browser chrome rects and safe-area / caption-band collision verification.

slots.name: scene_elements
slots.description: Pin of the browser chrome config and scene element boxes.

steps: Compute tab strip, omnibox and viewport boxes with compute_browser_chrome_layout.
Run verify_safe_area_and_caption_band across all stage elements and captions.

acceptance.check: valid is true and violations is empty when stage items stay in y: 72..820 and captions stay in y: 836..1080.

verbs.title: Validate zero-double-exposure transitions and evaluate aura and packet curves
verbs.summary: Check every shot-to-shot transition to reject text-on-text crossfades or dissolves, and compute clamped card aura opacities and quadratic Bezier edge-packet trajectories.
verbs.outcome: Transition validation result and sampled accent curve parameters.

slots.name: shot_transitions
slots.description: Pin of the shot list and transition sequence.

steps: Run validate_zero_double_exposure on the shot list and transition sequence.
Evaluate compute_card_aura and interpolate_edge_packet for focused pillar cards and inter-card connectors.

acceptance.check: No crossfade, dissolve or alpha_blend connects two shots with text or UI chrome.
Every sampled aura opacity is <= 0.22 and edge-packet endpoint opacities equal 0.0.

verbs.title: Compile the pre-render 3D composition verification summary
verbs.summary: Combine the Product Hub trajectory, browser viewport geometry, safe-area layout check and zero-double-exposure transition check into a conforming composition check report.
verbs.outcome: A conforming composition check noun ready before rendering.

slots.name: trajectory_plan
slots.description: Pin of the camera trajectory plan.

slots.name: layout_verification
slots.description: Pin of the safe-area and browser layout check.

slots.name: transition_verification
slots.description: Pin of the transition validation check.

steps: Assemble grid_mode, trajectory_duration_s, segment_count, browser_viewport_box, layout_valid and transitions_valid.
